questions.explanation:
Which of the following best summarizes paragraph 4? 
A. Despite receiving care in Arles, van Gogh’s mental condition remained unclear and influenced his 
later artwork. 
B. Sadly, van Gogh's mental health problems remained even after he was admitted to the hospital 
following the tragedy. 
C. He received treatment after the incident, but his emotional struggles persisted and puzzled 
future observers. 

D. Despite continuing to paint, van Gogh's worsening mental state left a lingering sadness for his later 
pieces of art. 
(Câu nào dưới đây tóm tắt đúng nhất nội dung của đoạn 4? 
A. Mặc dù được điều trị tại Arles, tình trạng tâm thần của van Gogh vẫn chưa rõ ràng và đã ảnh hưởng 
đến các tác phẩm sau này của ông. 
B. Đáng buồn thay, các vấn đề sức khỏe tâm thần của van Gogh vẫn tiếp diễn ngay cả sau khi ông nhập 
viện vì bi kịch đó. 
C. Ông được điều trị sau vụ việc, nhưng những đấu tranh cảm xúc vẫn tiếp diễn và khiến người đời sau 
bối rối. 
D. Dù tiếp tục vẽ, tình trạng tinh thần ngày càng tồi tệ của van Gogh đã để lại nỗi buồn dai dẳng trong 
những bức tranh sau này.) 
Giải thích: 
• A. ...influenced his later artwork - SAI: Đoạn 4 không nói ảnh hưởng đến tranh sau này. 
• B. ...problems remained even after... - SAI: Thiếu ý quan trọng về sự bí ẩn của nguyên nhân hành 
động. 
• C. He received treatment after the incident, but his emotional struggles persisted and puzzled 
future observers - ĐÚNG: Tóm tắt đủ các ý chính của đoạn 4: Điều trị sau vụ việc -> Bệnh không 
giảm -> Nguyên nhân vẫn là bí ẩn (puzzled observers/explored by writers). 
• D. ...lingering sadness... - SAI: Suy diễn cảm xúc không có trong bài

A. Sự phụ thuộc quá nhiều vào em trai gây căng thẳng.

C. Khó khăn trong việc được cộng đồng nghệ thuật chấp nhận. 
D. Gặp rắc rối tài chính do không bán được tranh.)

(không được công nhận) nói chung, nhưng không liệt kê cụ thể việc "khó khăn để được cộng đồng

hệ cá nhân). Bài nhấn mạnh vào sức khỏe và tài chính hơn. Lưu ý: Ý D nói về tài chính do không bán

so với các ý còn lại. 
• D. Financial struggles... - SAI: Có đề cập (financial problems, unable to support himself).

Read the following passage and choose the best answer to each of the following questions from 33 to 40. 
1. Bicultural individuals live within two or more cultures and develop the ability to adapt their attitudes, 
beliefs, and behaviors to different settings. They often merge cultural values and combine them in daily 
life. Research shows that biculturals have many advantages, such as wider social networks, stronger awareness 
of cultural differences, and the ability to act as links between communities. More recently, studies also suggest 
that bicultural people display greater creativity and achieve higher levels of professional success. 
2. Carmit Tadmor, Adam Galinsky, and William Maddux conducted several studies to test how 
biculturalism relates to creativity and innovation. In one study, MBA students in Europe who had lived abroad 
were asked to think of creative uses for a brick. The bicultural students offered more ideas, showed more 
flexibility, and suggested more original solutions. A second study in the United States investigated how many 
businesses or new products students had created. Once again, biculturals produced more innovative results 
than others. 

3. A third study examined Israeli professionals working in the United States, particularly in Silicon 
V alley. These individuals had lived there for an average of eight years. The results showed that biculturals 
were promoted more quickly and enjoyed stronger reputations among colleagues. Their adaptability and 
ability to use different perspectives helped them succeed at work more effectively than non-biculturals. 
4. Researchers explained these advantages through a process called integrative complexity. This is the 
capacity to consider competing perspectives and then combine them into new, coherent ideas. Biculturals 
often show this skill naturally, which allows them to manage uncertainty, search for solutions, and create fresh 
connections. However, the studies also suggest that non-biculturals can develop this ability, for example 
through debate, where one must argue for different sides of an issue.

Read the following passage and choose the best answer to each of the following questions from 33 to 40. 
1. Bicultural individuals live within two or more cultures and develop the ability to adapt their attitudes, 
beliefs, and behaviors to different settings. They often merge cultural values and combine them in daily 
life. Research shows that biculturals have many advantages, such as wider social networks, stronger awareness 
of cultural differences, and the ability to act as links between communities. More recently, studies also suggest 
that bicultural people display greater creativity and achieve higher levels of professional success. 
2. Carmit Tadmor, Adam Galinsky, and William Maddux conducted several studies to test how 
biculturalism relates to creativity and innovation. In one study, MBA students in Europe who had lived abroad 
were asked to think of creative uses for a brick. The bicultural students offered more ideas, showed more 
flexibility, and suggested more original solutions. A second study in the United States investigated how many 
businesses or new products students had created. Once again, biculturals produced more innovative results 
than others. 
3. A third study examined Israeli professionals working in the United States, particularly in Silicon 
V alley. These individuals had lived there for an average of eight years. The results showed that biculturals 
were promoted more quickly and enjoyed stronger reputations among colleagues. Their adaptability and 

ability to use different perspectives helped them succeed at work more effectively than non-biculturals. 
4. Researchers explained these advantages through a process called integrative complexity. This is the 
capacity to consider competing perspectives and then combine them into new, coherent ideas. Biculturals 
often show this skill naturally, which allows them to manage uncertainty, search for solutions, and create fresh 
connections. However, the studies also suggest that non-biculturals can develop this ability, for example 
through debate, where one must argue for different sides of an issue. 
 
Những người song văn hóa sống trong hai hay nhiều nền văn hóa khác nhau và phát triển khả năng 
thích nghi về thái độ, niềm tin và hành vi của mình trong các bối cảnh khác nhau. Họ thường dung hòa và kết 
hợp các giá trị văn hóa vào đời sống hằng ngày. Các nghiên cứu cho thấy người song văn hóa có nhiều lợi 
thế, chẳng hạn như mạng lưới xã hội rộng hơn, nhận thức sâu sắc hơn về sự khác biệt văn hóa và khả năng 
đóng vai trò cầu nối giữa các cộng đồng. Gần đây, các nghiên cứu cũng cho thấy người song văn hóa thể hiện 
mức độ sáng tạo cao hơn và đạt được thành công nghề nghiệp vượt trội hơn. 
Carmit Tadmor , Adam Galinsky và William Maddux đã thực hiện nhiều nghiên cứu để xem xét mối liên 
hệ giữa tính song văn hóa với sự sáng tạo và đổi mới. Trong một nghiên cứu, các sinh viên MBA ở châu Âu 
từng sống ở nước ngoài được yêu cầu nghĩ ra những cách sử dụng sáng tạo cho một viên gạch. Các sinh viên 
song văn hóa đưa ra nhiều ý tưởng hơn, thể hiện sự linh hoạt cao hơn và đề xuất những giải pháp độc đáo 
hơn. Một nghiên cứu thứ hai tại Hoa Kỳ tìm hiểu xem sinh viên đã thành lập được bao nhiêu doanh nghiệp 
hoặc sản phẩm mới. Một lần nữa, nhóm người song văn hóa tạo ra nhiều kết quả mang tính sáng tạo hơn so 
với các nhóm khác. 
Nghiên cứu thứ ba tập trung vào các chuyên gia người Israel làm việc tại Hoa Kỳ, đặc biệt là ở Thung 
lũng Silicon. Những người này đã sinh sống tại đây trung bình khoảng tám năm. Kết quả cho thấy họ được 
thăng chức nhanh hơn và có danh tiếng tốt hơn trong mắt đồng nghiệp. Khả năng thích nghi và tận dụng nhiều 
góc nhìn khác nhau đã giúp họ thành công trong công việc hiệu quả hơn so với những người không song văn 
hóa.

ý tưởng mới, mạch lạc. Người song văn hóa thường tự nhiên thể hiện được kỹ năng này, giúp họ xử lý sự không

2. Despite his artistic talent, van Gogh faced many challenges in his personal life. Born in 1853, he 
suffered from serious mental health conditions, including depression, anxiety, and later, epilepsy. These health 
problems made it difficult for him to keep strong personal relationships, and he often felt very lonely and 
isolated from others. His emotional struggles followed him throughout his life and deeply affected his

difficult to sell his paintings and was unable to support himself through his art. [III] Although Theo was kind 
and helpful, this situation caused stress in their relationship. [IV] One of the most dramatic events in van 
Gogh’s life happened in December 1888. After a serious argument with fellow artist Paul Gauguin, van Gogh 
cut off part of his own ear and gave it to a woman at a brothel.

treatment. Although he continued to paint after leaving the hospital, his mental health did not improve. The 

reasons behind his actions that night are still not fully understood, and many artists and writers have since 
explored the event in their works.

artworks during his lifetime. Sadly, he died by suicide in 1890 at the age of 37, feeling unrecognized. His work

Read the following passage and choose the best answer to each of the following questions from 23 to 32. 
1. Vincent van Gogh was a Dutch post-impressionist artist who became famous for his bold brushwork 
and vibrant colors. Some of his most well-known paintings include “Starry Night,” “Sunflowers,” and his 
various self-portraits. These pieces are now appreciated all over the world and are regularly displayed in 
museums and exhibitions. 
2. Despite his artistic talent, van Gogh faced many challenges in his personal life. Born in 1853, he 
suffered from serious mental health conditions, including depression, anxiety, and later, epilepsy. These health 
problems made it difficult for him to keep strong personal relationships, and he often felt very lonely and 
isolated from others. His emotional struggles followed him throughout his life and deeply affected his 
work and lifestyle. 
3. [I] In addition to his mental health issues, van Gogh also had financial problems. [II] He found it 
difficult to sell his paintings and was unable to support himself through his art. [III] Although Theo was kind 
and helpful, this situation caused stress in their relationship. [IV] One of the most dramatic events in van 
Gogh’s life happened in December 1888. After a serious argument with fellow artist Paul Gauguin, van Gogh 
cut off part of his own ear and gave it to a woman at a brothel. 
4. Following the incident, he was taken to a hospital in Arles, France, where he received medical 
treatment. Although he continued to paint after leaving the hospital, his mental health did not improve. The 

reasons behind his actions that night are still not fully understood, and many artists and writers have since 
explored the event in their works. 
5. Despite his difficulties, van Gogh remained dedicated to his art. He created more than 2,000 
artworks during his lifetime. Sadly, he died by suicide in 1890 at the age of 37, feeling unrecognized. His work 
only became famous after his death. Today, van Gogh is considered one of the greatest artists in history. His 
story highlights the importance of mental health and the emotional struggles faced by many creative 
individuals.

(Điều nào sau đây là đúng theo nội dung bài đọc? 
A. Mặc dù kỹ năng nhận thức giúp người đa văn hóa thích nghi, họ vẫn cần học cách xử lý sự không 
chắc chắn tốt hơn. 
B. Dù người song văn hóa thể hiện khả năng thích ứng và tư duy linh hoạt, họ vẫn bị giới hạn ở một 
góc nhìn duy nhất. 
C. Càng sống lâu trong môi trường đa văn hóa, con người càng trở nên sáng tạo và thành công hơn 
trong công việc.

khu vực địa lý cụ thể nào.)

quả về thời gian sống. 
• D. The relationship between biculturalism and creativity is not limited to a single demographic 
or geographic area - ĐÚNG: Các nghiên cứu được thực hiện ở Châu Âu, Mỹ, và với người Israel tại

questions.prompt: Chọn đáp án đúng nhất cho câu hỏi 1:

options.B: being trained based on a wide variety of data
options.C: which using deep learning techniques on extensive data sets
options.D: to be trained by a massive data set of text

questions.explanation:
A. that has been trained on large amounts of text data 
B. being trained based on a wide variety of data 
C. which using deep learning techniques on extensive data sets 
D. to be trained by a massive data set of text 
Giải thích: 
• A. that has been trained on large amounts of text data - ĐÚNG: Đây là mệnh đề quan hệ xác định 
bổ nghĩa cho danh từ "neural network architecture". Cấu trúc: "...architecture [that has been trained...]" 
(kiến trúc cái mà đã được huấn luyện...). 
• B. being trained based on a wide variety of data - SAI: Cụm phân từ "being trained" thường diễn tả 
hành động đang diễn ra hoặc bị động rút gọn, nhưng xét về ngữ pháp và tính mạch lạc, mệnh đề quan 
hệ (A) rõ ràng và chuẩn xác hơn trong văn phong định nghĩa. 
• C. which using deep learning techniques on extensive data sets - SAI: Sai ngữ pháp. Sau đại từ 
quan hệ "which" phải là một động từ chia thì (ví dụ: which uses), không thể dùng V-ing (using) ngay 
lập tức nếu không có to be. 
• D. to be trained by a massive data set of text - SAI: Cấu trúc "to be trained" chỉ mục đích hoặc tương 
lai, không phù hợp để mô tả đặc điểm đã hoàn thành của mô hình

CHAT GPT – TRÍ TUỆ NHÂN TẠO 
Chat GPT là một mô hình ngôn ngữ được phát triển bởi OpenAI, sử dụng các kỹ thuật học sâu để tạo ra những 
phản hồi giống con người đối với các câu hỏi hoặc yêu cầu bằng văn bản. GPT là viết tắt của “Generative Pre-
Trained Transformer”, là một loại kiến trúc mạng nơ-ron đã được huấn luyện trên một lượng lớn dữ liệu 
văn bản.

B. that makes it useful for a wide range of applications

quan hệ nối tiếp sau dấu phẩy để bổ nghĩa cho mệnh đề trước. 
• D. making it useful for a wide range of applications - ĐÚNG: Đây là dạng rút gọn mệnh đề quan hệ 
(mệnh đề kết quả), dùng V-ing (making) để thay thế cho "which makes...", diễn tả kết quả của hành 
động phía trước.

Most of us have taken a selfie at one time or another, be it a photo of ourselves in a beautiful place, 
during a performance by our favourite band, or on a memorable night out with friends. But today, more and 
more people are putting their lives at risk in an attempt to get the most shocking pictures to share on social 
media. In several cases, this action has had disastrous consequences. 
Take, for example, the Spaniard who was killed by a bull while he was taking a selfie during the annual 
bull run in a village near his hometown, or the Singaporean tourist who died when he fell from cliffs on the 
coast of Bali. Such tragedies have led to the death toll from selfie-related incidents reaching double figures 
for the first time in 2015, overtaking the number of victims of shark attacks. 
Despite the risks, social media is full of pictures featuring near misses that could have been fatal under 
other circumstances. Under the caption 'Most dangerous selfie ever', a woman posing at a stadium can be seen 
narrowly avoiding being hit in the head by a baseball approaching her. Y et the photo has received thousands 
of "likes", and the comments below it suggest that this behavior is something to be admired. 
In response to the increasing threat posed by the selfies, the authorities have started to take action. 
National parks, such as the Waterton Canyon in Denver, Colorado, have closed their gates to visitors 
approaching the bears for photos. The Russian Interior Ministry has launched a public education campaign 
advising selfie-takers not to balance on dangerous surfaces or pose with their pets. But if instructions like 
this are really necessary, then perhaps it is about time we asked ourselves which is more important, a 
'like' or a life?

Most of us have taken a selfie at one time or another, be it a photo of ourselves in a beautiful place, 
during a performance by our favourite band, or on a memorable night out with friends. But today, more and 
more people are putting their lives at risk in an attempt to get the most shocking pictures to share on social 
media. In several cases, this action has had disastrous consequences. 
Take, for example, the Spaniard who was killed by a bull while he was taking a selfie during the annual 
bull run in a village near his hometown, or the Singaporean tourist who died when he fell from cliffs on the 
coast of Bali. Such tragedies have led to the death toll from selfie-related incidents reaching double figures 
for the first time in 2015, overtaking the number of victims of shark attacks. 
Despite the risks, social media is full of pictures featuring near misses that could have been fatal under 
other circumstances. Under the caption 'Most dangerous selfie ever', a woman posing at a stadium can be seen 
narrowly avoiding being hit in the head by a baseball approaching her. Y et the photo has received thousands 
of "likes", and the comments below it suggest that this behavior is something to be admired. 
In response to the increasing threat posed by the selfies, the authorities have started to take action.  
National parks, such as the Waterton Canyon in Denver, Colorado, have closed their gates to visitors 
approaching the bears for photos. The Russian Interior Ministry has launched a public education campaign 
advising selfie-takers not to balance on dangerous surfaces or pose with their pets. But if instructions like 

this are really necessary, then perhaps it is about time we asked ourselves which is more important, a 
'like' or a life?

ở một nơi tuyệt đẹp, trong buổi biểu diễn của ban nhạc yêu thích, hoặc trong một đêm đáng nhớ cùng bạn bè. 
Thế nhưng ngày nay, ngày càng nhiều người đang đặt mạng sống của mình vào tình thế nguy hiểm chỉ để có

dẫn đến những hậu quả thảm khốc. 
Chẳng hạn, một người đàn ông Tây Ban Nha đã thiệt mạng vì bị bò húc trong khi đang chụp ảnh tự

người, mà trong hoàn cảnh khác có thể đã trở thành thảm họa thực sự. Dưới chú thích “Bức ảnh tự sướng

chày bay thẳng vào đầu. Thế nhưng, bức ảnh này lại nhận được hàng nghìn lượt “thích”, và các bình luận

công viên quốc gia, chẳng hạn như Waterton Canyon ở Denver , bang Colorado, đã đóng cửa khu vực cho

công cộng, khuyên người dân không nên leo lên những nơi nguy hiểm hay tạo dáng cùng thú nuôi khi chụp 
selfie. Nhưng nếu những hướng dẫn như vậy là thật sự cần thiết, thì có lẽ đã đến lúc chúng ta nên tự hỏi: điều 
gì quan trọng hơn — một lượt “thích” hay một mạng sống?

Which of the following is NOT mentioned as a cause of selfie-related accidents? 
A. Being hit by a bull     B. Drowning in the ocean  
C. Being struck by a baseball     D. Falling from cliffs

more people are putting their lives at risk in an attempt to get the most shocking pictures to share on social 
media. In several cases, this action has had disastrous consequences. 
Take, for example, the Spaniard who was killed by a bull while he was taking a selfie during the annual 
bull run in a village near his hometown, or the Singaporean tourist who died when he fell from cliffs on the 
coast of Bali. Such tragedies have led to the death toll from selfie-related incidents reaching double figures 
for the first time in 2015, overtaking the number of victims of shark attacks. 
Despite the risks, social media is full of pictures featuring near misses that could have been fatal under 
other circumstances. Under the caption 'Most dangerous selfie ever', a woman posing at a stadium can be seen 
narrowly avoiding being hit in the head by a baseball approaching her. Y et the photo has received thousands 
of "likes", and the comments below it suggest that this behavior is something to be admired. 
In response to the increasing threat posed by the selfies, the authorities have started to take action. 
National parks, such as the Waterton Canyon in Denver, Colorado, have closed their gates to visitors 
approaching the bears for photos. The Russian Interior Ministry has launched a public education campaign 
advising selfie-takers not to balance on dangerous surfaces or pose with their pets. But if instructions like 
this are really necessary, then perhaps it is about time we asked ourselves which is more important, a 
'like' or a life?

mạng xã hội.

hoàn toàn mục đích (Tuân thủ để an toàn, không phải để được like).

questions.explanation:
Which of the following is TRUE according to the passage? 
A. A majority of dangerous selfies lead to serious consequences, including death or injury. 

B. Shark attacks caused more deaths than selfies in 2015, according to reported statistics. 
C. Many people continue to admire and share risky selfies despite the obvious danger. 
D. Social media users are no longer interested in sharing or viewing dangerous selfies online. 
(Câu nào sau đây là ĐÚNG theo nội dung bài đọc? 
A. Phần lớn các bức ảnh selfie nguy hiểm dẫn đến hậu quả nghiêm trọng, bao gồm thương tích hoặc tử 
vong. 
B. Theo số liệu báo cáo, các vụ cá mập tấn công gây ra nhiều cái chết hơn selfie vào năm 2015. 
C. Nhiều người vẫn tiếp tục ngưỡng mộ và chia sẻ những bức ảnh selfie mạo hiểm dù biết rõ nguy 
hiểm. 
D. Người dùng mạng xã hội không còn quan tâm đến việc chia sẻ hay xem các bức selfie nguy hiểm 
nữa.) 
Giải thích: 
• A. A majority of dangerous selfies lead to serious consequences... - SAI: Bài nói "In several cases" 
(trong một số trường hợp), không phải "A majority" (phần lớn). 
• B. Shark attacks caused more deaths than selfies in 2015... - SAI: Ngược lại, bài nói selfie deaths 
"overtaking" (vượt qua) shark attacks. 
• C. Many people continue to admire and share risky selfies despite the obvious danger - ĐÚNG: 
Thông tin ở đoạn 3: "received thousands of 'likes', and the comments... suggest that this behavior is 
something to be admired". 
• D. Social media users are no longer interested... - SAI: Sai thực tế bài đọc.

Read the following passage and mark the letter A, B, C, or D on your answer sheet to indicate the best 
answer to each of the following questions from 14 to 23. 
Present-day climate change includes both global warming, the steady rise in Earth's average 
temperature and its broader effects on the planet's climate. [I] In a wider sense, climate change also includes 
long-term changes in Earth's climate in the past. [II] The current increase in global temperatures is mainly 
caused by human activities, especially the burning of fossil fuels since the Industrial Revolution. [III] Using 
fossil fuels, cutting down forests, and certain farming and industrial activities release greenhouse gases. [IV] 
Climate change has an increasingly large impact on the environment. Deserts are growing, heat waves 
and wildfires are happening more often. The faster warming in the Arctic has caused frozen ground to thaw, 
glaciers to shrink, and sea ice to disappear. Warmer temperatures are also making storms, droughts, and other 

extreme weather events stronger. Rapid changes in mountains, coral reefs, and the Arctic are forcing many 
animals and plants to move or even disappear. Even if we succeed in reducing future warming, some effects 
will last for hundreds of years. These include rising ocean temperatures, increasing ocean acidity, and higher 
sea levels. 
Climate change is a serious threat to people. It can lead to more floods, extreme heat, shortages of food 
and water, more diseases, and financial losses. It can also cause people to move to new places and even lead 
to conflicts. The World Health Organization considers climate change one of the biggest dangers to human 
health in the 21st century. If no action is taken to slow warming, both societies and ecosystems will face 
much bigger risks. 
Climate change can be mitigated by cutting down the amount of greenhouse gases released into the 
air and by increasing the removal of carbon dioxide from the atmosphere. To keep global warming below 1.5 
°C, the world must reach net-zero greenhouse gas emissions by 2050, or by 2070 to keep warming under 2 °C. 
This requires major and widespread changes in energy use, land use, cities, transportation, buildings, and 
industries.

Biến đổi khí hậu hiện nay bao gồm cả hiện tượng nóng lên toàn cầu — tức sự gia tăng ổn định của 
nhiệt độ trung bình Trái Đất — cùng với những tác động rộng hơn của nó đối với khí hậu hành tinh. [I] Ở 
nghĩa rộng hơn, biến đổi khí hậu còn bao gồm những thay đổi dài hạn của khí hậu Trái Đất trong quá khứ. 
[II] Sự gia tăng nhiệt độ toàn cầu hiện nay chủ yếu do các hoạt động của con người, đặc biệt là việc đốt nhiên 
liệu hóa thạch kể từ Cách mạng Công nghiệp. [III] Việc sử dụng nhiên liệu hóa thạch, chặt phá rừng, cùng 
với một số hoạt động nông nghiệp và công nghiệp đã thải ra khí nhà kính. [IV] 
Biến đổi khí hậu đang ngày càng tác động mạnh mẽ hơn đến môi trường. Sa mạc đang mở rộng, các 
đợt nắng nóng và cháy rừng xảy ra thường xuyên hơn. Tình trạng ấm lên nhanh hơn ở Bắc Cực đã khiến đất 
đóng băng tan chảy, sông băng thu nhỏ và băng biển biến mất. Nhiệt độ tăng cao cũng làm các cơn bão, hạn 
hán và hiện tượng thời tiết cực đoan khác trở nên dữ dội hơn. Sự thay đổi nhanh chóng ở vùng núi, rạn san 
hô và Bắc Cực đang buộc nhiều loài động, thực vật phải di chuyển hoặc thậm chí tuyệt chủng. Dù con người 
có thành công trong việc giảm mức độ ấm lên trong tương lai, một số tác động vẫn sẽ kéo dài hàng trăm năm, 
bao gồm nhiệt độ đại dương tăng, độ axit của nước biển cao hơn và mực nước biển dâng. 
Biến đổi khí hậu là mối đe dọa nghiêm trọng đối với con người. Nó có thể gây ra nhiều trận lũ lụt hơn, 
nắng nóng cực độ, thiếu lương thực và nước, nhiều dịch bệnh hơn và tổn thất kinh tế nặng nề. Nó cũng có thể 
khiến con người phải di cư đến nơi khác và thậm chí dẫn đến xung đột. Tổ chức Y tế Thế giới (WHO) coi biến 
đổi khí hậu là một trong những mối nguy lớn nhất đối với sức khỏe con người trong thế kỷ 21. Nếu không có 
hành động kịp thời để làm chậm quá trình ấm lên, cả xã hội lẫn các hệ sinh thái sẽ phải đối mặt với những rủi 
ro lớn hơn nhiều. 
Biến đổi khí hậu có thể được giảm thiểu bằng cách cắt giảm lượng khí nhà kính thải ra không khí và 
tăng khả năng loại bỏ khí CO₂ khỏi bầu khí quyển. Để giữ mức tăng nhiệt toàn cầu dưới 1,5°C, thế giới cần 
đạt mức phát thải ròng bằng 0 vào năm 2050, hoặc trước năm 2070 để giới hạn mức ấm lên dưới 2°C. Điều 
này đòi hỏi những thay đổi lớn và toàn diện trong sử dụng năng lượng, đất đai, quy hoạch đô thị, giao thông, 
công trình xây dựng và công nghiệp.

Which paragraph does the following sentence best fit? 
These gases trap some of the heat that the Earth gives off after absorbing sunlight, making the lower 
atmosphere warmer. 
A. [IV]   B. [III]    C. [II]    D. [I] 
(Đoạn nào trong bài là vị trí phù hợp nhất để chèn câu sau đây? 
“Các khí này giữ lại một phần nhiệt mà Trái Đất tỏa ra sau khi hấp thụ ánh sáng Mặt Trời, khiến tầng 
khí quyển thấp trở nên ấm hơn.” 

A. [IV]   B. [III]    C. [II]    D. [I]) 
Giải thích: 
• A. [IV] - ĐÚNG: Câu cần điền "These gases trap some of the heat..." (Những khí này giữ nhiệt...). Nó 
giải thích cơ chế của "greenhouse gases" được nhắc đến ngay trước đó ở câu [III] ("...release 
greenhouse gases."). Vị trí [IV] là hợp lý nhất để nối tiếp dòng tư duy: Nguyên nhân thải khí -> Khí

questions.explanation:
The phrase “caused frozen ground to thaw” in paragraph 2 could be best replaced by 
____________. 
A. created heavy snowfall    B. froze the surface of the Earth 
C. protected frozen landscapes   D. made icy soil melt 
(Cụm từ “caused frozen ground to thaw” trong đoạn 2 có thể được thay thế tốt nhất bằng ____________. 
A. tạo ra tuyết rơi dày đặc    B. làm đông cứng bề mặt Trái Đất 
C. bảo vệ các vùng đất đóng băng   D. khiến lớp đất băng tan chảy) 
Giải thích: 
• A. created heavy snowfall - SAI: Tạo tuyết rơi. 
• B. froze the surface of the Earth - SAI: Làm đông cứng. 
• C. protected frozen landscapes - SAI: Bảo vệ. 
• D. made icy soil melt - ĐÚNG: "Thaw" nghĩa là tan chảy (từ trạng thái đông cứng). Cụm "caused 
frozen ground to thaw" đồng nghĩa với "made icy soil melt" (làm đất đóng băng tan chảy).

Read the following passage and mark the letter A, B, C, or D on your answer sheet to indicate the best

Most of us have taken a selfie at one time or another, be it a photo of ourselves in a beautiful place, 
during a performance by our favourite band, or on a memorable night out with friends. But today, more and 
more people are putting their lives at risk in an attempt to get the most shocking pictures to share on social 
media. In several cases, this action has had disastrous consequences. 
Take, for example, the Spaniard who was killed by a bull while he was taking a selfie during the annual 
bull run in a village near his hometown, or the Singaporean tourist who died when he fell from cliffs on the 
coast of Bali. Such tragedies have led to the death toll from selfie-related incidents reaching double figures 
for the first time in 2015, overtaking the number of victims of shark attacks. 
Despite the risks, social media is full of pictures featuring near misses that could have been fatal under 
other circumstances. Under the caption 'Most dangerous selfie ever', a woman posing at a stadium can be seen 
narrowly avoiding being hit in the head by a baseball approaching her. Y et the photo has received thousands 
of "likes", and the comments below it suggest that this behavior is something to be admired. 
In response to the increasing threat posed by the selfies, the authorities have started to take action. 
National parks, such as the Waterton Canyon in Denver, Colorado, have closed their gates to visitors 
approaching the bears for photos. The Russian Interior Ministry has launched a public education campaign 
advising selfie-takers not to balance on dangerous surfaces or pose with their pets. But if instructions like 
this are really necessary, then perhaps it is about time we asked ourselves which is more important, a 
'like' or a life?

answer to each of the following questions from 14 to 23. 
Present-day climate change includes both global warming, the steady rise in Earth's average 
temperature and its broader effects on the planet's climate. [I] In a wider sense, climate change also includes 
long-term changes in Earth's climate in the past. [II] The current increase in global temperatures is mainly 
caused by human activities, especially the burning of fossil fuels since the Industrial Revolution. [III] Using 
fossil fuels, cutting down forests, and certain farming and industrial activities release greenhouse gases. [IV] 
Climate change has an increasingly large impact on the environment. Deserts are growing, heat waves 
and wildfires are happening more often. The faster warming in the Arctic has caused frozen ground to thaw, 
glaciers to shrink, and sea ice to disappear. Warmer temperatures are also making storms, droughts, and other 

extreme weather events stronger. Rapid changes in mountains, coral reefs, and the Arctic are forcing many 
animals and plants to move or even disappear. Even if we succeed in reducing future warming, some effects 
will last for hundreds of years. These include rising ocean temperatures, increasing ocean acidity, and higher 
sea levels. 
Climate change is a serious threat to people. It can lead to more floods, extreme heat, shortages of food 
and water, more diseases, and financial losses. It can also cause people to move to new places and even lead 
to conflicts. The World Health Organization considers climate change one of the biggest dangers to human 
health in the 21st century. If no action is taken to slow warming, both societies and ecosystems will face 
much bigger risks. 
Climate change can be mitigated by cutting down the amount of greenhouse gases released into the 
air and by increasing the removal of carbon dioxide from the atmosphere. To keep global warming below 1.5 
°C, the world must reach net-zero greenhouse gas emissions by 2050, or by 2070 to keep warming under 2 °C. 
This requires major and widespread changes in energy use, land use, cities, transportation, buildings, and 
industries.

atmosphere warmer.

questions.explanation:
Which of the following best summarises paragraph 2? 
A. It discusses the effects of rising ocean temperatures and how these leads to melting ice and other 
serious environmental changes. 
B. It outlines how climate change has evolved over time and the growing challenges humanity faces as 
a result. 
C. It explains how fossil fuel usage has contributed to the acceleration of climate change and its long-
term effects on the planet. 
D. It describes various environmental impacts of climate change, including changes in weather 
patterns and the loss of ecosystems. 
(Đáp án nào sau đây tóm tắt tốt nhất đoạn 2? 
A. Đoạn này bàn về tác động của việc nhiệt độ đại dương tăng và cách hiện tượng đó dẫn đến băng tan 
cùng các biến đổi môi trường nghiêm trọng khác. 
B. Đoạn này trình bày cách biến đổi khí hậu phát triển theo thời gian và những thách thức ngày càng 
lớn mà loài người phải đối mặt. 
C. Đoạn này giải thích việc sử dụng nhiên liệu hóa thạch đã góp phần làm gia tăng tốc độ biến đổi khí 
hậu và các tác động lâu dài của nó đối với hành tinh. 
D. Đoạn này mô tả nhiều tác động môi trường khác nhau của biến đổi khí hậu, bao gồm thay đổi kiểu 

thời tiết và mất mát hệ sinh thái.) 
Giải thích: 
• A. It discusses the effects of rising ocean temperatures... - SAI: Quá hẹp. 
• B. It outlines how climate change has evolved... - SAI: Sai nội dung. 
• C. It explains how fossil fuel usage... - SAI: Sai (đoạn 1 mới nói về nguyên nhân này). 
• D. It describes various environmental impacts of climate change, including changes in weather 
patterns and the loss of ecosystems - ĐÚNG: Đoạn 2 liệt kê hàng loạt tác động môi trường: sa mạc 
hóa, cháy rừng, băng tan, bão, hạn hán, sinh vật di cư/tuyệt chủng.

questions.explanation:
Which of the following best paraphrases the underlined sentence in paragraph 3? 
A. Without intervention, human societies are likely to face greater risks than natural ecosystems from 
climate change. 
B. If warming continues without intervention, both human societies and ecosystems will be at 
greater risk. 
C. Without reducing the level of warming, rising temperatures could primarily put human societies at 
risk. 
D. If we choose not to act on climate change, the planet may eventually recover without major damage. 
(Câu nào dưới đây diễn đạt lại tốt nhất câu được gạch chân trong đoạn 3? 
A. Nếu không có biện pháp can thiệp, xã hội loài người có thể phải đối mặt với rủi ro lớn hơn so với 
các hệ sinh thái. 
B. Nếu quá trình nóng lên tiếp diễn mà không được kiểm soát, cả xã hội loài người và các hệ sinh thái 
đều sẽ gặp rủi ro lớn hơn. 
C. Nếu không giảm mức độ nóng lên, nhiệt độ tăng cao có thể chủ yếu đe dọa đến các cộng đồng con 
người. 
D. Nếu chúng ta chọn không hành động trước biến đổi khí hậu, hành tinh có thể tự phục hồi mà không 
chịu thiệt hại nghiêm trọng.) 
Giải thích: 
• A. ...greater risks than ecosystems... - SAI: Bài không so sánh ai rủi ro hơn ai. 
• B. If warming continues without intervention, both human societies and ecosystems will be at 
greater risk - ĐÚNG: Paraphrase chuẩn: 
o "If no action is taken" = "If warming continues without intervention". 
o "both societies and ecosystems" giữ nguyên. 
o "face much bigger risks" = "at greater risk". 
• C. ...primarily put human societies at risk - SAI: Thiếu "ecosystems". 
• D. ...recover without major damage - SAI: Ngược nghĩa hoàn toàn.

Đoạn cuối nói cần "major and widespread changes in energy use, land use, cities, transportation..." ->

Most of us have taken a selfie at one time or another, be it a photo of ourselves in a beautiful place, 
during a performance by our favourite band, or on a memorable night out with friends. But today, more and 
more people are putting their lives at risk in an attempt to get the most shocking pictures to share on social

for the first time in 2015, overtaking the number of victims of shark attacks.

other circumstances. Under the caption 'Most dangerous selfie ever', a woman posing at a stadium can be seen 
narrowly avoiding being hit in the head by a baseball approaching her. Y et the photo has received thousands 
of "likes", and the comments below it suggest that this behavior is something to be admired. 
In response to the increasing threat posed by the selfies, the authorities have started to take action. 
National parks, such as the Waterton Canyon in Denver, Colorado, have closed their gates to visitors 
approaching the bears for photos. The Russian Interior Ministry has launched a public education campaign 
advising selfie-takers not to balance on dangerous surfaces or pose with their pets. But if instructions like 
this are really necessary, then perhaps it is about time we asked ourselves which is more important, a 
'like' or a life?

Present-day climate change includes both global warming, the steady rise in Earth's average 
temperature and its broader effects on the planet's climate. [I] In a wider sense, climate change also includes 
long-term changes in Earth's climate in the past. [II] The current increase in global temperatures is mainly 
caused by human activities, especially the burning of fossil fuels since the Industrial Revolution. [III] Using 
fossil fuels, cutting down forests, and certain farming and industrial activities release greenhouse gases. [IV] 
Climate change has an increasingly large impact on the environment. Deserts are growing, heat waves 
and wildfires are happening more often. The faster warming in the Arctic has caused frozen ground to thaw, 
glaciers to shrink, and sea ice to disappear. Warmer temperatures are also making storms, droughts, and other 

extreme weather events stronger. Rapid changes in mountains, coral reefs, and the Arctic are forcing many 
animals and plants to move or even disappear. Even if we succeed in reducing future warming, some effects 
will last for hundreds of years. These include rising ocean temperatures, increasing ocean acidity, and higher 
sea levels. 
Climate change is a serious threat to people. It can lead to more floods, extreme heat, shortages of food 
and water, more diseases, and financial losses. It can also cause people to move to new places and even lead 
to conflicts. The World Health Organization considers climate change one of the biggest dangers to human 
health in the 21st century. If no action is taken to slow warming, both societies and ecosystems will face 
much bigger risks. 
Climate change can be mitigated by cutting down the amount of greenhouse gases released into the 
air and by increasing the removal of carbon dioxide from the atmosphere. To keep global warming below 1.5 
°C, the world must reach net-zero greenhouse gas emissions by 2050, or by 2070 to keep warming under 2 °C. 
This requires major and widespread changes in energy use, land use, cities, transportation, buildings, and 
industries.

atmosphere warmer.

Which of the following best summarises the passage? 
A. The Industrial Revolution contributed significantly to climate change, but other human actions are 
also important causes of global warming. 
B. Climate change has significantly affected the Arctic region so far, while other regions have 
experienced only minor environmental consequences. 
C. Climate change driven by human activities is causing significant environmental damage, but 
it is possible to reduce its effects through global efforts. 
D. Climate change is a long-term process that is gradually affecting various ecosystems, although its 
exact impact on human life remains a subject of ongoing study. 

(Đáp án nào sau đây tóm tắt tốt nhất toàn bộ bài đọc? 
A. Cuộc Cách mạng Công nghiệp góp phần đáng kể vào biến đổi khí hậu, nhưng các hành động khác 
của con người cũng là nguyên nhân quan trọng gây ra hiện tượng nóng lên toàn cầu. 
B. Biến đổi khí hậu cho đến nay đã ảnh hưởng nghiêm trọng đến khu vực Bắc Cực, trong khi các vùng 
khác chỉ chịu hậu quả môi trường nhỏ hơn. 
C. Biến đổi khí hậu do hoạt động của con người đang gây ra thiệt hại nghiêm trọng cho môi trường, 
nhưng hoàn toàn có thể giảm bớt tác động của nó thông qua nỗ lực toàn cầu. 
D. Biến đổi khí hậu là một quá trình dài hạn đang dần ảnh hưởng đến nhiều hệ sinh thái khác nhau, 
mặc dù mức độ tác động của nó lên đời sống con người vẫn đang được nghiên cứu thêm.) 
Giải thích: 
• A. ...other human actions are also important... - SAI: Tóm tắt thiếu phần hậu quả và giải pháp. 
• B. ...minor environmental consequences... - SAI: Sai sự thật bài đọc. 
• C. Climate change driven by human activities is causing significant environmental damage, but 
it is possible to reduce its effects through global efforts - ĐÚNG: Tóm tắt đủ 3 ý chính: 
1. Nguyên nhân: Human activities. 
2. Hậu quả: Significant environmental damage. 
3. Giải pháp: Possible to reduce through efforts (mitigation). 
• D. ...impact on human life remains a subject of ongoing study - SAI: Bài đã khẳng định tác động 
nghiêm trọng lên con người, không phải "vẫn đang nghiên cứu xem sao".

Most of us have taken a selfie at one time or another, be it a photo of ourselves in a beautiful place, 
during a performance by our favourite band, or on a memorable night out with friends. But today, more and

bull run in a village near his hometown, or the Singaporean tourist who died when he fell from cliffs on the 
coast of Bali. Such tragedies have led to the death toll from selfie-related incidents reaching double figures

other circumstances. Under the caption 'Most dangerous selfie ever', a woman posing at a stadium can be seen 
narrowly avoiding being hit in the head by a baseball approaching her. Y et the photo has received thousands 
of "likes", and the comments below it suggest that this behavior is something to be admired. 
In response to the increasing threat posed by the selfies, the authorities have started to take action. 
National parks, such as the Waterton Canyon in Denver, Colorado, have closed their gates to visitors 
approaching the bears for photos. The Russian Interior Ministry has launched a public education campaign 
advising selfie-takers not to balance on dangerous surfaces or pose with their pets. But if instructions like 
this are really necessary, then perhaps it is about time we asked ourselves which is more important, a 
'like' or a life?

Present-day climate change includes both global warming, the steady rise in Earth's average 
temperature and its broader effects on the planet's climate. [I] In a wider sense, climate change also includes 
long-term changes in Earth's climate in the past. [II] The current increase in global temperatures is mainly 
caused by human activities, especially the burning of fossil fuels since the Industrial Revolution. [III] Using 
fossil fuels, cutting down forests, and certain farming and industrial activities release greenhouse gases. [IV] 
Climate change has an increasingly large impact on the environment. Deserts are growing, heat waves 
and wildfires are happening more often. The faster warming in the Arctic has caused frozen ground to thaw, 
glaciers to shrink, and sea ice to disappear. Warmer temperatures are also making storms, droughts, and other 

extreme weather events stronger. Rapid changes in mountains, coral reefs, and the Arctic are forcing many 
animals and plants to move or even disappear. Even if we succeed in reducing future warming, some effects 
will last for hundreds of years. These include rising ocean temperatures, increasing ocean acidity, and higher 
sea levels. 
Climate change is a serious threat to people. It can lead to more floods, extreme heat, shortages of food 
and water, more diseases, and financial losses. It can also cause people to move to new places and even lead 
to conflicts. The World Health Organization considers climate change one of the biggest dangers to human 
health in the 21st century. If no action is taken to slow warming, both societies and ecosystems will face 
much bigger risks. 
Climate change can be mitigated by cutting down the amount of greenhouse gases released into the 
air and by increasing the removal of carbon dioxide from the atmosphere. To keep global warming below 1.5 
°C, the world must reach net-zero greenhouse gas emissions by 2050, or by 2070 to keep warming under 2 °C. 
This requires major and widespread changes in energy use, land use, cities, transportation, buildings, and 
industries.

Read the following passage and mark the letter A, B, C, or D on your answer sheet to indicate the best 
answer to each of the following questions from 6 to 13. 
Most of us have taken a selfie at one time or another, be it a photo of ourselves in a beautiful place, 
during a performance by our favourite band, or on a memorable night out with friends. But today, more and 
more people are putting their lives at risk in an attempt to get the most shocking pictures to share on social 
media. In several cases, this action has had disastrous consequences. 
Take, for example, the Spaniard who was killed by a bull while he was taking a selfie during the annual 
bull run in a village near his hometown, or the Singaporean tourist who died when he fell from cliffs on the 
coast of Bali. Such tragedies have led to the death toll from selfie-related incidents reaching double figures 
for the first time in 2015, overtaking the number of victims of shark attacks. 
Despite the risks, social media is full of pictures featuring near misses that could have been fatal under 
other circumstances. Under the caption 'Most dangerous selfie ever', a woman posing at a stadium can be seen 
narrowly avoiding being hit in the head by a baseball approaching her. Y et the photo has received thousands 
of "likes", and the comments below it suggest that this behavior is something to be admired. 
In response to the increasing threat posed by the selfies, the authorities have started to take action. 
National parks, such as the Waterton Canyon in Denver, Colorado, have closed their gates to visitors 
approaching the bears for photos. The Russian Interior Ministry has launched a public education campaign 
advising selfie-takers not to balance on dangerous surfaces or pose with their pets. But if instructions like 
this are really necessary, then perhaps it is about time we asked ourselves which is more important, a 
'like' or a life?

A. bad luck  B. bad injuries   C. dull moments  D. sad events

A. harmless  B. serious   C. painful   D. life-threatening

A. visitors  B. National parks  C. the bears   D. the Waterton Canyon

B. Authorities focus more on social media likes than public safety, which is problematic. 
C. Life seems to matter only when one gains significant attention and validation on social media 
platforms. 
D. People should follow safety instructions carefully if they want to gain more likes on social media.

A. A majority of dangerous selfies lead to serious consequences, including death or injury. 
B. Shark attacks caused more deaths than selfies in 2015, according to reported statistics. 
C. Many people continue to admire and share risky selfies despite the obvious danger. 
D. Social media users are no longer interested in sharing or viewing dangerous selfies online.

Read the following passage and mark the letter A, B, C, or D on your answer sheet to indicate the best 
answer to each of the following questions from 14 to 23. 
Present-day climate change includes both global warming, the steady rise in Earth's average 
temperature and its broader effects on the planet's climate. [I] In a wider sense, climate change also includes 
long-term changes in Earth's climate in the past. [II] The current increase in global temperatures is mainly 
caused by human activities, especially the burning of fossil fuels since the Industrial Revolution. [III] Using 
fossil fuels, cutting down forests, and certain farming and industrial activities release greenhouse gases. [IV] 
Climate change has an increasingly large impact on the environment. Deserts are growing, heat waves 
and wildfires are happening more often. The faster warming in the Arctic has caused frozen ground to thaw, 
glaciers to shrink, and sea ice to disappear. Warmer temperatures are also making storms, droughts, and other 

extreme weather events stronger. Rapid changes in mountains, coral reefs, and the Arctic are forcing many 
animals and plants to move or even disappear. Even if we succeed in reducing future warming, some effects 
will last for hundreds of years. These include rising ocean temperatures, increasing ocean acidity, and higher 
sea levels. 
Climate change is a serious threat to people. It can lead to more floods, extreme heat, shortages of food 
and water, more diseases, and financial losses. It can also cause people to move to new places and even lead 
to conflicts. The World Health Organization considers climate change one of the biggest dangers to human 
health in the 21st century. If no action is taken to slow warming, both societies and ecosystems will face 
much bigger risks. 
Climate change can be mitigated by cutting down the amount of greenhouse gases released into the 
air and by increasing the removal of carbon dioxide from the atmosphere. To keep global warming below 1.5 
°C, the world must reach net-zero greenhouse gas emissions by 2050, or by 2070 to keep warming under 2 °C. 
This requires major and widespread changes in energy use, land use, cities, transportation, buildings, and 
industries. 
Question 14. Which paragraph does the following sentence best fit? 
These gases trap some of the heat that the Earth gives off after absorbing sunlight, making the lower 
atmosphere warmer. 
A. [IV]   B. [III]    C. [II]    D. [I]

A. created heavy snowfall    B. froze the surface of the Earth

A. Rising sea levels     B. Effects of climate change 
C. Greenhouse gases     D. Rising ocean temperatures 
Question 17. Which of the following is NOT mentioned as an effect of climate change in the passage? 
A. water contamination    B. economic losses  
C. extreme weather events    D. food shortages 
Question 18. Which of the following best summarises paragraph 2? 
A. It discusses the effects of rising ocean temperatures and how these leads to melting ice and other 
serious environmental changes. 
B. It outlines how climate change has evolved over time and the growing challenges humanity faces as 
a result. 
C. It explains how fossil fuel usage has contributed to the acceleration of climate change and its long-

term effects on the planet. 
D. It describes various environmental impacts of climate change, including changes in weather patterns 
and the loss of ecosystems. 
Question 19. The word “mitigated” in paragraph 4 is OPPOSITE in meaning to ____________. 
A. alleviated  B. ignored   C. increased   D. reduced 
Question 20. Which of the following is TRUE according to the passage? 
A. Climate change mainly affects certain regions that often experience unusual weather conditions. 
B. Ocean warming and rising sea levels are likely to reverse naturally without human intervention. 
C. Most environmental changes caused by climate change can be fixed within a short period of time. 
D. Human actions are widely recognized as a primary factor contributing to the current global warming. 
Question 21. Which of the following best paraphrases the underlined sentence in paragraph 3? 
A. Without intervention, human societies are likely to face greater risks than natural ecosystems from 
climate change. 
B. If warming continues without intervention, both human societies and ecosystems will be at greater 
risk. 
C. Without reducing the level of warming, rising temperatures could primarily put human societies at 
risk. 
D. If we choose not to act on climate change, the planet may eventually recover without major damage. 
Question 22. Which of the following can be inferred from the passage? 
A. The World Health Organization considers climate change the greatest threat to human health in the 
21st century. 
B. Substantial changes in human consumption can reduce the effect of climate. 
C. Governments around the world have already made great progress in reducing the negative effects 
of climate change. 
D. Climate change is a global issue that can be solved quickly with minimal effort and resources.

A. other  B. the other   C. the others   D. others  
Giải thích: 
• A. other - SAI: + N số nhiều. 
• B. the other - ĐÚNG: Có tổng cộng 4 bản copy. Câu trước nói: "On two copies..." (Trên 2 bản...). Câu 
này nói: "...on the other two copies" (trên 2 bản còn lại). Dùng "the other" khi đã xác định cụ thể số 
lượng còn lại trong một tập hợp. 
• C. the others - SAI: Đại từ, không đi kèm danh từ "two copies" phía sau. 
• D. others - SAI: Đại từ.

THÔNG BÁO CỦA HIỆP HỘI THƯƠNG MẠI QUỐC TẾ – ICA 
Kêu gọi gửi bài tham luận 
Một số lượng đáng kể đề xuất thuyết trình về bất kỳ khía cạnh nào của thương mại quốc tế được mời gửi, 
bao gồm các lĩnh vực như tài chính, kế toán, marketing, quảng cáo, luật, chính sách đối ngoại và năng lực ứng 
xử đa văn hoá. 
Do những giới hạn về không gian, các đề xuất liên quan đến công nghệ kinh doanh, nhân sự và bảo hiểm sẽ 
không được xem xét. 
Theo chính sách của ICA, mỗi người chỉ được trình bày một lần trong suốt hội nghị và cũng chỉ được đảm 
nhận vai trò chủ tọa phiên họp một lần. 
Tất cả các đề xuất cần bao gồm: 
✓ Phiếu đăng ký đính kèm, chỉ rõ hình thức thuyết trình. 
✓ Bốn bản tóm tắt dài 250 từ, đánh máy, giãn dòng đôi. Trên hai bản, ghi tên của mỗi diễn giả. Không ghi bất 
kỳ thông tin nhận dạng nào trên hai bản còn lại. 
✓ Mẫu yêu cầu thiết bị nghe nhìn. 

Ban tuyển chọn sẽ xem xét kỹ lưỡng tất cả các đề xuất trước khi đưa ra quyết định cuối cùng.

for the first time in 2015, overtaking the number of victims of shark attacks.

Most of us have taken a selfie at one time or another, be it a photo of ourselves in a beautiful place, 
during a performance by our favourite band, or on a memorable night out with friends. But today, more and 
more people are putting their lives at risk in an attempt to get the most shocking pictures to share on social 
media. In several cases, this action has had disastrous consequences. 
Take, for example, the Spaniard who was killed by a bull while he was taking a selfie during the annual 
bull run in a village near his hometown, or the Singaporean tourist who died when he fell from cliffs on the 
coast of Bali. Such tragedies have led to the death toll from selfie-related incidents reaching double figures 
for the first time in 2015, overtaking the number of victims of shark attacks.

other circumstances. Under the caption 'Most dangerous selfie ever', a woman posing at a stadium can be seen 
narrowly avoiding being hit in the head by a baseball approaching her. Y et the photo has received thousands 
of "likes", and the comments below it suggest that this behavior is something to be admired. 
In response to the increasing threat posed by the selfies, the authorities have started to take action. 
National parks, such as the Waterton Canyon in Denver, Colorado, have closed their gates to visitors 
approaching the bears for photos. The Russian Interior Ministry has launched a public education campaign 
advising selfie-takers not to balance on dangerous surfaces or pose with their pets. But if instructions like 
this are really necessary, then perhaps it is about time we asked ourselves which is more important, a 
'like' or a life?

A. d – e – a – c – b B. d – b – c – a – e  C. d – c – e – b – a  D. d – a – b – e – c  
Giải thích: 
1⃣ d. The traditional art of storytelling in our village is at serious risk of fading away unless we take 

steps to protect it. 
• Giải thích: Câu này mở đoạn rất tự nhiên, giới thiệu chủ đề chính – sự mai một của nghệ thuật kể 
chuyện dân gian trong làng. 
• 
🗣 Dịch: Nghệ thuật kể chuyện truyền thống ở làng chúng ta đang đứng trước nguy cơ phai nhạt 
nghiêm trọng nếu chúng ta không có biện pháp bảo tồn. 
2⃣ a. Many elders in our community, who have long been the keepers of these tales, have passed away 
without passing on their knowledge to the younger generation, risking the loss of our cultural heritage. 
• Giải thích: Câu này mở rộng nguyên nhân đầu tiên cho ý d — những người cao tuổi, người giữ gìn 
kho tàng truyện cổ, dần mất đi mà không kịp truyền lại kiến thức, dẫn đến nguy cơ mất mát di sản văn 
hóa. 
• 
🗣 Dịch: Nhiều bậc cao niên trong cộng đồng – những người lâu nay giữ gìn kho tàng truyện kể – đã 
qua đời mà chưa kịp truyền lại kiến thức cho thế hệ trẻ, khiến di sản văn hóa của chúng ta có nguy cơ 
bị mai một. 
3⃣ b. In the past, these stories were shared during festivals, where families and neighbors would gather, 
helping to keep the tradition alive and strengthen community bonds. 
• Giải thích: Câu này cung cấp bối cảnh quá khứ, cho thấy truyền thống kể chuyện từng gắn liền với 
lễ hội và đời sống cộng đồng, giúp duy trì sự gắn kết và truyền thống văn hóa. 
•

Read the following passage and mark the letter A, B, C, or D on your answer sheet to indicate the best 
answer to each of the following questions from 6 to 13. 
Most of us have taken a selfie at one time or another, be it a photo of ourselves in a beautiful place, 
during a performance by our favourite band, or on a memorable night out with friends. But today, more and 
more people are putting their lives at risk in an attempt to get the most shocking pictures to share on social 
media. In several cases, this action has had disastrous consequences. 
Take, for example, the Spaniard who was killed by a bull while he was taking a selfie during the annual 
bull run in a village near his hometown, or the Singaporean tourist who died when he fell from cliffs on the 
coast of Bali. Such tragedies have led to the death toll from selfie-related incidents reaching double figures 
for the first time in 2015, overtaking the number of victims of shark attacks. 
Despite the risks, social media is full of pictures featuring near misses that could have been fatal under 
other circumstances. Under the caption 'Most dangerous selfie ever', a woman posing at a stadium can be seen 
narrowly avoiding being hit in the head by a baseball approaching her. Y et the photo has received thousands 
of "likes", and the comments below it suggest that this behavior is something to be admired. 
In response to the increasing threat posed by the selfies, the authorities have started to take action. 
National parks, such as the Waterton Canyon in Denver, Colorado, have closed their gates to visitors 
approaching the bears for photos. The Russian Interior Ministry has launched a public education campaign 
advising selfie-takers not to balance on dangerous surfaces or pose with their pets. But if instructions like 
this are really necessary, then perhaps it is about time we asked ourselves which is more important, a 
'like' or a life?

A. harmless  B. serious   C. painful   D. life-threatening

risk.

C. Life seems to matter only when one gains significant attention and validation on social media 
platforms. 
D. People should follow safety instructions carefully if they want to gain more likes on social media.

answer to each of the following questions from 14 to 23. 
Present-day climate change includes both global warming, the steady rise in Earth's average 
temperature and its broader effects on the planet's climate. [I] In a wider sense, climate change also includes 
long-term changes in Earth's climate in the past. [II] The current increase in global temperatures is mainly 
caused by human activities, especially the burning of fossil fuels since the Industrial Revolution. [III] Using 
fossil fuels, cutting down forests, and certain farming and industrial activities release greenhouse gases. [IV] 
Climate change has an increasingly large impact on the environment. Deserts are growing, heat waves 
and wildfires are happening more often. The faster warming in the Arctic has caused frozen ground to thaw, 
glaciers to shrink, and sea ice to disappear. Warmer temperatures are also making storms, droughts, and other 

extreme weather events stronger. Rapid changes in mountains, coral reefs, and the Arctic are forcing many 
animals and plants to move or even disappear. Even if we succeed in reducing future warming, some effects 
will last for hundreds of years. These include rising ocean temperatures, increasing ocean acidity, and higher 
sea levels. 
Climate change is a serious threat to people. It can lead to more floods, extreme heat, shortages of food 
and water, more diseases, and financial losses. It can also cause people to move to new places and even lead 
to conflicts. The World Health Organization considers climate change one of the biggest dangers to human 
health in the 21st century. If no action is taken to slow warming, both societies and ecosystems will face 
much bigger risks. 
Climate change can be mitigated by cutting down the amount of greenhouse gases released into the 
air and by increasing the removal of carbon dioxide from the atmosphere. To keep global warming below 1.5 
°C, the world must reach net-zero greenhouse gas emissions by 2050, or by 2070 to keep warming under 2 °C. 
This requires major and widespread changes in energy use, land use, cities, transportation, buildings, and 
industries.

atmosphere warmer.

Most of us have taken a selfie at one time or another, be it a photo of ourselves in a beautiful place, 
during a performance by our favourite band, or on a memorable night out with friends. But today, more and 
more people are putting their lives at risk in an attempt to get the most shocking pictures to share on social 
media. In several cases, this action has had disastrous consequences.

bull run in a village near his hometown, or the Singaporean tourist who died when he fell from cliffs on the 
coast of Bali. Such tragedies have led to the death toll from selfie-related incidents reaching double figures 
for the first time in 2015, overtaking the number of victims of shark attacks.

other circumstances. Under the caption 'Most dangerous selfie ever', a woman posing at a stadium can be seen 
narrowly avoiding being hit in the head by a baseball approaching her. Y et the photo has received thousands 
of "likes", and the comments below it suggest that this behavior is something to be admired. 
In response to the increasing threat posed by the selfies, the authorities have started to take action. 
National parks, such as the Waterton Canyon in Denver, Colorado, have closed their gates to visitors 
approaching the bears for photos. The Russian Interior Ministry has launched a public education campaign 
advising selfie-takers not to balance on dangerous surfaces or pose with their pets. But if instructions like 
this are really necessary, then perhaps it is about time we asked ourselves which is more important, a 
'like' or a life?

câu (động từ chính là "are").

Most of us have taken a selfie at one time or another, be it a photo of ourselves in a beautiful place, 
during a performance by our favourite band, or on a memorable night out with friends. But today, more and 
more people are putting their lives at risk in an attempt to get the most shocking pictures to share on social 
media. In several cases, this action has had disastrous consequences. 
Take, for example, the Spaniard who was killed by a bull while he was taking a selfie during the annual 
bull run in a village near his hometown, or the Singaporean tourist who died when he fell from cliffs on the 
coast of Bali. Such tragedies have led to the death toll from selfie-related incidents reaching double figures 
for the first time in 2015, overtaking the number of victims of shark attacks. 
Despite the risks, social media is full of pictures featuring near misses that could have been fatal under 
other circumstances. Under the caption 'Most dangerous selfie ever', a woman posing at a stadium can be seen 
narrowly avoiding being hit in the head by a baseball approaching her. Y et the photo has received thousands 
of "likes", and the comments below it suggest that this behavior is something to be admired. 
In response to the increasing threat posed by the selfies, the authorities have started to take action. 
National parks, such as the Waterton Canyon in Denver, Colorado, have closed their gates to visitors 
approaching the bears for photos. The Russian Interior Ministry has launched a public education campaign 
advising selfie-takers not to balance on dangerous surfaces or pose with their pets. But if instructions like 
this are really necessary, then perhaps it is about time we asked ourselves which is more important, a 
'like' or a life?

Most of us have taken a selfie at one time or another, be it a photo of ourselves in a beautiful place, 
during a performance by our favourite band, or on a memorable night out with friends. But today, more and 
more people are putting their lives at risk in an attempt to get the most shocking pictures to share on social 
media. In several cases, this action has had disastrous consequences. 
Take, for example, the Spaniard who was killed by a bull while he was taking a selfie during the annual 
bull run in a village near his hometown, or the Singaporean tourist who died when he fell from cliffs on the 
coast of Bali. Such tragedies have led to the death toll from selfie-related incidents reaching double figures 
for the first time in 2015, overtaking the number of victims of shark attacks. 
Despite the risks, social media is full of pictures featuring near misses that could have been fatal under 
other circumstances. Under the caption 'Most dangerous selfie ever', a woman posing at a stadium can be seen 
narrowly avoiding being hit in the head by a baseball approaching her. Y et the photo has received thousands 
of "likes", and the comments below it suggest that this behavior is something to be admired. 
In response to the increasing threat posed by the selfies, the authorities have started to take action. 
National parks, such as the Waterton Canyon in Denver, Colorado, have closed their gates to visitors 
approaching the bears for photos. The Russian Interior Ministry has launched a public education campaign 
advising selfie-takers not to balance on dangerous surfaces or pose with their pets. But if instructions like 
this are really necessary, then perhaps it is about time we asked ourselves which is more important, a 
'like' or a life?

Present-day climate change includes both global warming, the steady rise in Earth's average 
temperature and its broader effects on the planet's climate. [I] In a wider sense, climate change also includes 
long-term changes in Earth's climate in the past. [II] The current increase in global temperatures is mainly 
caused by human activities, especially the burning of fossil fuels since the Industrial Revolution. [III] Using 
fossil fuels, cutting down forests, and certain farming and industrial activities release greenhouse gases. [IV] 
Climate change has an increasingly large impact on the environment. Deserts are growing, heat waves 
and wildfires are happening more often. The faster warming in the Arctic has caused frozen ground to thaw, 
glaciers to shrink, and sea ice to disappear. Warmer temperatures are also making storms, droughts, and other 

extreme weather events stronger. Rapid changes in mountains, coral reefs, and the Arctic are forcing many 
animals and plants to move or even disappear. Even if we succeed in reducing future warming, some effects 
will last for hundreds of years. These include rising ocean temperatures, increasing ocean acidity, and higher 
sea levels. 
Climate change is a serious threat to people. It can lead to more floods, extreme heat, shortages of food 
and water, more diseases, and financial losses. It can also cause people to move to new places and even lead 
to conflicts. The World Health Organization considers climate change one of the biggest dangers to human 
health in the 21st century. If no action is taken to slow warming, both societies and ecosystems will face 
much bigger risks. 
Climate change can be mitigated by cutting down the amount of greenhouse gases released into the 
air and by increasing the removal of carbon dioxide from the atmosphere. To keep global warming below 1.5 
°C, the world must reach net-zero greenhouse gas emissions by 2050, or by 2070 to keep warming under 2 °C. 
This requires major and widespread changes in energy use, land use, cities, transportation, buildings, and 
industries.

questions.explanation:
A. inspire B. inspired   C. inspiring   D. inspiration 
Giải thích: 
• A. inspire - SAI: Động từ chủ động. 
• B. inspired - ĐÚNG: Cấu trúc bị động get + V-ed/V3 (get inspired - được truyền cảm hứng). Ngữ cảnh 
khuyên người đọc hãy để bản thân được truyền cảm hứng. 
• C. inspiring - SAI: Tính từ chủ động (gây cảm hứng). 
• D. inspiration - SAI: Danh từ. 
 
❆ Sống Tối Giản, Phong Cách Bắc Cực! 
Đang tìm cảm hứng trong thế giới những ngôi nhà nhỏ xinh? Hãy cùng chúng tôi đến Greenland và khám phá 

những ngôi nhà sáng tạo của người Inuit. Trong nhiều thế kỷ, họ đã xây dựng những nơi trú ẩn chứng minh 
rằng bạn không cần nhiều không gian để có một mái nhà che đầu. 
Ngôi nhà băng nổi tiếng, được làm từ những khối tuyết, trông có vẻ đơn giản nhưng lại là một thiết kế cứu 
mạng. Chỉ với một căn phòng, nó giúp các gia đình an toàn và ấm áp suốt những mùa đông Bắc Cực dài. Hình 
mái vòm và bức tường dày thể hiện sức mạnh của kiến trúc tự nhiên. 
Nhưng igloo không phải là toàn bộ câu chuyện. Người Inuit còn sống trong những túp lều bằng cỏ, được 
dựng từ đá, gỗ trôi và cỏ khô. Những túp lều này kiên cố, bền chắc và nằm gần biển để thợ săn có thể đi lại 
bằng thuyền kayak. Khi di chuyển từ nơi này sang nơi khác, các gia đình Inuit dựng lên những lều da thú — 
nhẹ, dễ mang theo và có khả năng che chắn tốt. 
❆ Tham gia Trải Nghiệm Ngôi Nhà Bắc Cực Nhỏ! 
Hãy bước vào lịch sử, cảm nhận văn hóa và được truyền cảm hứng để thiết kế cho mình một cuộc sống giản 
đơn và bền vững. Truy cập ngay www.tinyarcticlife.com.

questions.group: Phần 3: Sắp Xếp Câu & Đoạn Văn (Câu 13 - 17)
questions.prompt: Chọn đáp án đúng nhất cho câu hỏi 13:
questions.explanation:
A. duty  B. career   C. job    D. work 
Giải thích: 
• A. duty - SAI: Nhiệm vụ. 
• B. career - ĐÚNG: Career (sự nghiệp) là quá trình làm việc lâu dài. Ngữ cảnh nói về việc tìm đam mê 
để xây dựng tương lai và sự nghiệp ý nghĩa. 
• C. job - SAI: Công việc ngắn hạn/cụ thể. 
• D. work - SAI: Công việc chung chung (không đếm được).

questions.group: Phần 3: Sắp Xếp Câu & Đoạn Văn (Câu 13 - 17)
questions.prompt: Chọn đáp án đúng nhất cho câu hỏi 14:
questions.explanation:
A. you  B. they   C. it    D. we 
Giải thích: 
• A. you - SAI. 
• B. they - ĐÚNG: Đại từ they thay thế cho danh từ số nhiều our natural gifts (những năng khiếu bẩm 
sinh) ở phía trước. "...chúng (các năng khiếu) dường như quá bình thường với chúng ta". 
• C. it - SAI. 
• D. we - SAI.

questions.group: Phần 3: Sắp Xếp Câu & Đoạn Văn (Câu 13 - 17)
questions.prompt: Chọn đáp án đúng nhất cho câu hỏi 15:
questions.explanation:
A. having described    B. to describe  
         C. described     D. that describes 
Giải thích: 
• A. having described - SAI: Nhấn mạnh hành động đã hoàn tất (không hợp ngữ cảnh mệnh đề quan hệ). 
• B. to describe - SAI: Thường chỉ mục đích hoặc tương lai. 
• C. described - SAI: Bị động (câu này cần chủ động: câu văn miêu tả mục tiêu). 
• D. that describes - ĐÚNG: Mệnh đề quan hệ chủ động đầy đủ (sentence that describes your goal - câu 
văn miêu tả mục tiêu của bạn)

questions.group: Phần 3: Sắp Xếp Câu & Đoạn Văn (Câu 13 - 17)
questions.prompt: Chọn đáp án đúng nhất cho câu hỏi 16:
questions.explanation:
A. passion B. passionate   C. passionately  D. passionless 
Giải thích: 
• A. passion - ĐÚNG: Sau tính từ sở hữu your cần một danh từ. Passion (niềm đam mê) phù hợp ngữ 

nghĩa "đam mê dẫn lối bạn". 
• B. passionate - SAI: Tính từ.

lối.

questions.explanation:
A. The inappropriate and negative actions of teenagers often result from the fact that their parents don’t 
place enough trust in them 
B. If parents believe that their children will behave improperly, teenagers could often react by behaving 
accordingly 
C. When parents assume that teenage behavior will be negative, adolescents often behave in line 
with those assumptions 
D. Parents’ negative prejudices about teenagers make them lose confidence in themselves and doubt 
their ability to be responsible 
Giải thích: 
• ĐÚNG: Đáp án C. 
o Đoạn văn nói về tác động của kỳ vọng cha mẹ (parents' expectations). 
o C (When parents assume that teenage behavior will be negative, adolescents often behave in 
line with those assumptions) diễn giải đúng ý: Cha mẹ nghĩ con tiêu cực -> con sẽ hành xử tiêu 
cực (Self-fulfilling prophecy) ,. 
o A và D tập trung vào "trust" và "confidence" (không sát nghĩa "expectations" và "behaving 
accordingly"). B dùng từ improperly và cấu trúc could often react kém tự nhiên. 

Dịch: Các nghiên cứu tiếp theo cho thấy kỳ vọng của cha mẹ cũng đóng vai trò quan trọng. Khi cha mẹ cho 
rằng hành vi tuổi teen sẽ tiêu cực, thanh thiếu niên thường cư xử theo đúng những giả định đó. Theo 
Science Daily, nếu cha mẹ coi việc mạo hiểm hay nổi loạn là “hành vi bình thường của tuổi teen”, điều này có 
thể củng cố các định kiến tương tự từ xã hội và làm tăng khả năng xuất hiện các hành vi đó.

Mặc dù có tài năng nghệ thuật xuất chúng, van Gogh lại phải đối mặt với nhiều khó khăn trong cuộc 
sống cá nhân. Sinh năm 1853, ông mắc phải các chứng rối loạn sức khỏe tâm thần nghiêm trọng, bao gồm 
trầm cảm, lo âu và sau này là bệnh động kinh. Những vấn đề này khiến ông khó duy trì các mối quan hệ thân 
thiết, và ông thường cảm thấy cô đơn, tách biệt khỏi mọi người. Những đấu tranh về tinh thần ấy đeo bám ông 
suốt đời và ảnh hưởng sâu sắc đến cả tác phẩm lẫn lối sống của ông. 
Ngoài các vấn đề về sức khỏe tinh thần, van Gogh còn gặp rắc rối về tài chính. Ông rất khó bán tranh 
và không thể tự nuôi sống bản thân bằng nghệ thuật của mình. Mặc dù người em trai Theo luôn tốt bụng và 
giúp đỡ, hoàn cảnh này vẫn khiến mối quan hệ giữa hai người trở nên căng thẳng. Một trong những sự kiện 
bi kịch nhất trong đời van Gogh xảy ra vào tháng 12 năm 1888: sau một cuộc cãi vã nghiêm trọng với họa sĩ 
Paul Gauguin, van Gogh đã tự cắt một phần tai mình và mang tặng cho một phụ nữ ở nhà chứa. 
Sau vụ việc, ông được đưa vào bệnh viện ở Arles, Pháp, để điều trị y tế. Dù tiếp tục vẽ tranh sau khi 
xuất viện, tình trạng tinh thần của ông vẫn không được cải thiện. Nguyên nhân khiến ông hành động như vậy 
trong đêm hôm đó vẫn chưa bao giờ được hiểu rõ hoàn toàn, và kể từ đó, nhiều nghệ sĩ và nhà văn đã khai 
thác sự kiện này trong các tác phẩm của họ. 
Dù gặp nhiều khó khăn, van Gogh vẫn kiên định với nghệ thuật. Trong suốt cuộc đời, ông đã sáng tạo 
hơn 2.000 tác phẩm nghệ thuật. Đáng buồn thay, ông qua đời do tự sát vào năm 1890, khi mới 37 tuổi, trong 
cảm giác bị lãng quên và không được công nhận. Chỉ sau khi ông mất, các tác phẩm của ông mới trở nên nổi 
tiếng. Ngày nay, van Gogh được xem là một trong những họa sĩ vĩ đại nhất trong lịch sử. Câu chuyện cuộc đời 
ông nhấn mạnh tầm quan trọng của sức khỏe tinh thần và những đấu tranh cảm xúc mà nhiều người nghệ sĩ 
phải đối mặt.

1. Vincent van Gogh was a Dutch post-impressionist artist who became famous for his bold brushwork 
and vibrant colors. Some of his most well-known paintings include “Starry Night,” “Sunflowers,” and his 
various self-portraits. These pieces are now appreciated all over the world and are regularly displayed in 
museums and exhibitions. 
2. Despite his artistic talent, van Gogh faced many challenges in his personal life. Born in 1853, he 
suffered from serious mental health conditions, including depression, anxiety, and later, epilepsy. These health 
problems made it difficult for him to keep strong personal relationships, and he often felt very lonely and 
isolated from others. His emotional struggles followed him throughout his life and deeply affected his 
work and lifestyle. 
3. [I] In addition to his mental health issues, van Gogh also had financial problems. [II] He found it 
difficult to sell his paintings and was unable to support himself through his art. [III] Although Theo was kind 
and helpful, this situation caused stress in their relationship. [IV] One of the most dramatic events in van 
Gogh’s life happened in December 1888. After a serious argument with fellow artist Paul Gauguin, van Gogh 
cut off part of his own ear and gave it to a woman at a brothel. 
4. Following the incident, he was taken to a hospital in Arles, France, where he received medical 
treatment. Although he continued to paint after leaving the hospital, his mental health did not improve. The 

reasons behind his actions that night are still not fully understood, and many artists and writers have since 
explored the event in their works. 
5. Despite his difficulties, van Gogh remained dedicated to his art. He created more than 2,000 
artworks during his lifetime. Sadly, he died by suicide in 1890 at the age of 37, feeling unrecognized. His work 
only became famous after his death. Today, van Gogh is considered one of the greatest artists in history. His 
story highlights the importance of mental health and the emotional struggles faced by many creative 
individuals.

questions.explanation:
Which of the following best paraphrases the underlined sentence in paragraph 2? 
A. Not only did his way of living change, but his artistic work also led to lifelong emotional issues. 
B. Throughout his life, he faced emotional problems that influenced both his work and his daily 
life. 
C. Emotional struggles followed him for many years, which altered his artwork and personal life. 
D. The emotional pain he endured throughout his life influenced his lifestyle and altered his artistic 
style 
(Câu nào dưới đây diễn đạt đúng nhất nội dung của câu gạch chân trong đoạn 2? 
A. Không chỉ lối sống của ông thay đổi mà chính nghệ thuật của ông cũng dẫn đến những vấn đề cảm 
xúc kéo dài suốt đời. 
B. Suốt cuộc đời, ông phải đối mặt với các vấn đề cảm xúc ảnh hưởng đến cả công việc và cuộc sống 
hằng ngày. 
C. Những đấu tranh cảm xúc theo đuổi ông nhiều năm, khiến tác phẩm và đời sống cá nhân của ông 
thay đổi. 
D. Nỗi đau tinh thần mà ông chịu đựng trong suốt cuộc đời đã ảnh hưởng đến lối sống và làm thay đổi 
phong cách nghệ thuật của ông.) 
Giải thích: 
• ĐÚNG: Đáp án B. 
o Câu gốc: "His emotional struggles followed him throughout his life and deeply affected his 
work and lifestyle." (Đấu tranh cảm xúc theo ông suốt đời và ảnh hưởng sâu sắc đến tác phẩm 
và lối sống). 
o B: Throughout his life, he faced emotional problems that influenced both his work and his daily 
life. -> Paraphrase chính xác từng thành phần: Throughout his life = followed him throughout 
his life; influenced = affected; work and daily life = work and lifestyle. 
o A sai quan hệ nhân quả (nghệ thuật gây ra vấn đề cảm xúc). C và D dùng từ altered (làm thay 
đổi/biến đổi) quá mạnh so với affected (ảnh hưởng), và D thêm ý artistic style không có trong 
câu gốc.
